Wedding Crasher

Wedding Crasher is a hybrid cannabis strain created by crossing Wedding Cake with Purple Punch. Bred by Symbiotic Genetics, this cultivar brings together two dessert-inspired lineages known for layered aroma and balanced character. Wedding Crasher is often associated with sweet berry notes supported by creamy vanilla and subtle earthy depth. Many consumers describe a smooth, steady experience that combines gentle mood lift with relaxed body ease, making it a versatile hybrid that does not lean strongly in either direction.

Browse available cannabis strains at Kind Goods dispensaries in Missouri now.

Home » Strains » Wedding Crasher

Genetics

The genetics behind Wedding Crasher combine two widely recognized parent strains:

  • Wedding Cake
  • Purple Punch


Wedding Crasher was developed by Symbiotic Genetics and is generally described as a hybrid. Wedding Cake contributes creamy, vanilla-leaning characteristics with earthy depth, while Purple Punch is known for berry-forward sweetness. Together, these genetics create a cultivar widely recognized for its dessert-inspired aromatic profile.

effects

Consumers commonly describe Wedding Crasher as balanced and steady, with:

  • A light uplift in mood
  • Gentle physical relaxation
  • A calm and clear mental presence

Since it sits between indica and sativa traits, some people enjoy it in social settings, while others prefer it during quieter moments later in the day. As with any cannabis product, individual experiences may vary depending on tolerance and batch.

Taste & Aroma

Wedding Crasher is often recognized for a layered aromatic profile that includes:

  • Sweet berry notes
  • Creamy vanilla character
  • Earthy undertones
  • Subtle gassy accents


Berry sweetness often comes first, followed by a creamy, slightly earthy finish. The aroma reflects the influence of both Purple Punch’s fruit-forward profile and the richer dessert-like notes associated with Wedding Cake.

Terpenes

Specific terpene dominance can vary depending on cultivation practices and harvest conditions. Wedding Crasher is commonly associated with terpene families found in its parent strains, including.

  • Caryophyllene, linked with peppery and earthy aromas
  • Limonene, associated with bright citrus notes
  • Myrcene, often described as herbal and musky

The exact terpene profile may vary by cultivator, so reviewing product-specific lab results is the best way to understand the composition of a particular batch.

Wedding Crasher Strain FAQs

Why is the strain called Wedding Crasher?

The name Wedding Crasher reflects the strain’s connection to its parent genetics, Wedding Cake and Purple Punch. Cannabis breeders often create names that reference lineage or flavor character. In this case, the name highlights the influence of Wedding Cake while introducing a new hybrid profile.

Who created the Wedding Crasher strain?

Wedding Crasher was bred by Symbiotic Genetics, a cannabis breeder known for developing modern hybrid cultivars. The strain was created by combining Wedding Cake with Purple Punch. This pairing brings together two well-known dessert-inspired genetic lines.

Is Wedding Crasher considered a modern cannabis strain?

Yes, Wedding Crasher is part of a newer generation of hybrid cultivars developed through the selective breeding of well-known strains. Its lineage combines Wedding Cake and Purple Punch, two modern varieties widely recognized on dispensary menus.

How does Wedding Crasher compare to other dessert-inspired strains?

Wedding Crasher shares traits with other dessert-style cultivars due to its Wedding Cake and Purple Punch lineage. These strains are often associated with sweet and layered aromatic profiles. Wedding Crasher blends those dessert-like qualities with a balanced hybrid structure.
